{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "mzumsande",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "raised concern about msghand thread blocking and offline reindexing limitations"
    },
    {
      "login": "hodlinator",
      "stance": "question",
      "note": "asked whether low-work offline reindexing could error out and advise lowering minimumchainwork"
    },
    {
      "login": "l0rinc",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK and verified the fix with a reproducer test"
    },
    {
      "login": "gmaxwell",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "warned that advising users to lower minimumchainwork violates assumevalid security assumptions"
    },
    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "questioned approach complexity, offline reindex behavior, and whether the fix is worth the squeeze"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "r:3449234404",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "connecting blocks during P2P message processing would block msghand for hours, causing peer disconnects and stalling handshakes",
      "quote": "This could block the thread hours, in which no other peer would be processed, so existing peers will get disconnected (ping timeout)",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3564555819"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:3564555819",
      "settled_by_quote": "the outstanding blocks will be connected on the background init thread; the p2p message processing thread will reject any new blocks while the outstanding blocks are being connected."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:3449234404",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "reindexing while offline does not work if the local chainwork is below minimumchainwork",
      "quote": "attempting to reindex while offline wouldn't work anymore if we are below minchainwork.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:3524198301"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "c:3524198301",
      "settled_by_quote": "I don't think it is particularly important that reindex be able to complete offline... IBD does not work offline anyway."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3584137905",
      "kind": "safety",
      "harm": "advising users to lower minimumchainwork violates the security assumption of assumevalid by making it easier to trick users into accepting an invalid chain",
      "quote": "So I think advising anywhere to change that value is not a good idea... As it is, however, it does break my security assumptions in a way that concerns me.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5713589740",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "introduces high complexity and breaks offline reindexing for an uncommon salvage scenario",
      "quote": "This is a quite complicated change for what should be such a simple concept! ... Maybe the juice is also just not worth the squeeze for a salvage scenario that does not happen often.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:3570695985",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "confirmed via reproducer that assumevalid is now respected during reindex below minimumchainwork",
      "substantive": true
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Initial record. mzumsande's msghand blocking concern was resolved by offloading deferred block connection to the background init thread, but sedited's approach critique and gmaxwell's security remarks remain open."
}
